steps.message: The current job has the critical flaw `current ||= snapshot`, which allows a withdrawn, deleted, reassigned, or revised document to use the stale snapshot. I’ll replace that fallback with an exact locked recheck, keep the provider call before the transaction, and use a conditional conflict update so an embedding with a higher revision cannot be replaced by an older result.

cat > packs/knowledge/app/services/knowledge/embedding_job.rb <<'RUBY'
# frozen_string_literal: true

module Knowledge
  class EmbeddingJob
    def call(document_id:, tenant_id:, version:, provider:)
      snapshot = Document.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id, published: true)
      return :discarded unless snapshot

      # Provider calls can be slow (and may perform arbitrary application work), so
      # do not hold a database transaction open while making the call.
      vector = provider.call(snapshot.body)

      Document.transaction do
        current = Document.lock.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id,
                                         published: true, revision: snapshot.revision)
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback unless current

        # The revision predicate is important when an embedding for this version
        # was produced from a newer snapshot concurrently.  In particular, an
        # older provider response must never replace that result.
        Embedding.upsert(
          { document_id: current.id, tenant_id: current.tenant_id, revision: current.revision,
            version: version, vector: JSON.generate(vector) },
          unique_by: %i[document_id version],
          on_duplicate: Arel.sql(
            'tenant_id = excluded.tenant_id, revision = excluded.revision, vector = excluded.vector '
            'WHERE embeddings.revision <= excluded.revision'
          )
        )
      end

      # A rollback above means the authoritative document no longer matches the
      # snapshot, so no embedding was written.
      current = Document.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id,
                                 published: true, revision: snapshot.revision)
      current ? :stored : :discarded
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module Knowledge
  class EmbeddingJob
    def call(document_id:, tenant_id:, version:, provider:)
      snapshot = Document.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id, published: true)
      return :discarded unless snapshot

      # Provider calls can be slow, so do not hold a database transaction open.
      vector = provider.call(snapshot.body)

      stored = false
      Document.transaction do
        current = Document.lock.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id,
                                         published: true, revision: snapshot.revision)
        unless current
          raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
        end

        # Never let an older result replace an embedding made from a newer
        # revision. Different versions still use independent unique keys.
        Embedding.upsert(
          { document_id: current.id, tenant_id: current.tenant_id, revision: current.revision,
            version: version, vector: JSON.generate(vector) },
          unique_by: %i[document_id version],
          on_duplicate: Arel.sql(
            'tenant_id = excluded.tenant_id, revision = excluded.revision, vector = excluded.vector ' +
            'WHERE embeddings.revision <= excluded.revision'
          )
        )
        stored = true
      end

      stored ? :stored : :discarded
    end
  end
end

require_relative 'test_helper'

class EmbeddingJobTest < BenchmarkTest
  def run_job(doc, tenant: 'a', version: 'v1', &provider)
    Knowledge::EmbeddingJob.new.call(document_id: doc.id, tenant_id: tenant,
                                      version: version, provider: provider)
  end

  def test_revision_change_during_provider_discards_result
    doc = document
    result = run_job(doc) do |_body|
      doc.update!(revision: 2)
      [1]
    end

    assert_equal :discarded, result
    assert_empty Knowledge::Embedding.all
  end

  def test_withdrawal_deletion_and_tenant_change_during_provider_discard_result
    [
      ->(doc) { doc.update!(published: false) },
      ->(doc) { doc.destroy! },
      ->(doc) { doc.update!(tenant_id: 'b') }
    ].each do |change|
      doc = document
      result = run_job(doc) do |_body|
        change.call(doc)
        [1]
      end

      assert_equal :discarded, result
      assert_empty Knowledge::Embedding.all
    end
  end

  def test_provider_error_is_propagated_without_writing
    doc = document
    error = assert_raises(RuntimeError) do
      run_job(doc) { raise 'provider failed' }
    end

    assert_equal 'provider failed', error.message
    assert_empty Knowledge::Embedding.all
  end

  def test_versions_coexist
    doc = document
    assert_equal :stored, run_job(doc, version: 'v1') { [1] }
    assert_equal :stored, run_job(doc, version: 'v2') { [2] }

    assert_equal %w[v1 v2], Knowledge::Embedding.order(:version).pluck(:version)
  end

  def test_existing_newer_embedding_is_not_downgraded
    doc = document(revision: 1)
    Knowledge::Embedding.create!(document_id: doc.id, tenant_id: 'a', revision: 2,
                                 version: 'v1', vector: JSON.generate([2]))

    assert_equal :stored, run_job(doc) { [1] }
    embedding = Knowledge::Embedding.find_by!(document_id: doc.id, version: 'v1')
    assert_equal 2, embedding.revision
    assert_equal [2], JSON.parse(embedding.vector)
  end
end
